set(miniz_dir "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/vendor/miniz")
set(lzma_sdk_dir "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/vendor/lzma-sdk")

# Build only the read side of miniz. Its export header is normally generated by
# its top-level build, and no export annotations are needed for static linking.
file(WRITE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/miniz_export.h" "#define MINIZ_EXPORT\n")
add_library(media_zip_decoder STATIC
    "${miniz_dir}/miniz.c"
    "${miniz_dir}/miniz_tinfl.c"
    "${miniz_dir}/miniz_zip.c"
)
target_include_directories(media_zip_decoder SYSTEM PUBLIC
    "${miniz_dir}" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}"
)
target_compile_definitions(media_zip_decoder PUBLIC
    MINIZ_NO_STDIO MINIZ_NO_ZLIB_APIS MINIZ_NO_ZLIB_COMPATIBLE_NAMES
    MINIZ_NO_DEFLATE_APIS
)

set(lzma_sdk_sources
    7zArcIn 7zBuf 7zBuf2 7zCrc 7zCrcOpt 7zDec 7zStream Bcj2 Bra Bra86 BraIA64
    CpuArch Delta LzmaDec Lzma2Dec Ppmd7 Ppmd7Dec
)
list(TRANSFORM lzma_sdk_sources PREPEND "${lzma_sdk_dir}/")
list(TRANSFORM lzma_sdk_sources APPEND ".c")
add_library(media_7z_decoder STATIC ${lzma_sdk_sources})
target_include_directories(media_7z_decoder SYSTEM PUBLIC "${lzma_sdk_dir}")
target_compile_definitions(media_7z_decoder PRIVATE Z7_PPMD_SUPPORT Z7_EXTRACT_ONLY)

add_library(media_archive STATIC media_archive.cpp)
target_include_directories(media_archive PRIVATE "${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/include")
target_link_libraries(media_archive PRIVATE media_zip_decoder media_7z_decoder)
